column1: # Why measures: the TXL twin of ltra4_1_line, stepped at tmax=0.5 ns
# against 1 ns edges. The pointwise gate trips at the 41 ns ringing peak
# of v(2), where the reference reads 5.06 V and RSpice on the same grid
# 5.45 V; refining ngspice's own step 50x takes it to 5.285 V and RSpice
# to 5.290 V, so the coarse-grid reference is 4 percent short of the
# value both simulators converge to. Under 10x refinement the reference's
# crossings move by up to 44 ps, its late overshoot peak by 6 percent
# and its settled means by up to 23 mV; RSpice sits within 40 ps, 2
# percent and 18 mV, always on the converged side.
# Source: v1 PULSE 0->4 V at 1 ns, 4->0 V at 22 ns, period 40 ns (1 ns
# edges). v(2) = driver output into the line, v(3) = line far end at the
# diode load. Tolerances are twice the larger of the reference's
